title: A picked layer wears the solid accent ring the mocks draw
goal: Every mock draws a picked thing with a solid accent-coloured ring; the app draws a faint dashed blue line instead, on every layer and on the zoomed recording ring alike. Build the mock ring, or put the choice to the user if a solid line cannot stay legible over arbitrary screenshots.
notes: Seen 2026-10-12 while building a-zoomed-recording-shows-its-ring-on-the-frame-n: the frame ring now lands on the frame (picture /tmp/photonz-playtest/framing-a-zoom-keys-its-centre-walk/3-framed-at-5-sc.png, copied to queue/audits/2026-10-12-zoom-frame-ring-3-framed-sc.png) but wears the app-wide layerOutlineLayer style: systemBlue at 0.6 alpha, lineWidth 2, lineDashPattern [2,4] (CanvasView.swift around line 2163). Mock: docs/design/mocks/shared/components/selection.css .sel-ring, and video-zoom-wt.html #frameRing. Changing it touches every picked layer, so check legibility over screenshots (the dashes were likely chosen for that) and open a decision card with both filmed if a solid ring does not hold up.
acceptance: A picked layer at Next defaults is outlined with a solid accent ring of the mock weight (selection.css .sel-ring: 1.5px accent)
The ring stays legible over a white screenshot, a blue one and a dark one, in light and dark
Walk pictures of a picked layer and of a pushed-in recording show the solid ring

log.note: Reproduced: framing-a-zoom-keys-its-centre-walk 3-framed-at-5-sc.png showed the faint dotted blue ring (systemBlue 0.6, 2pt, dash [2,4]) on the pushed-in recording.

Review before building: a bare 1.5pt accent line is invisible on a blue screenshot (prototyped over white/accent blue/pale/dark/grey in /tmp/ringproto). Casing it in a 3pt white halo at 0.6 keeps it legible everywhere and still reads as one line, so no decision card: the halo goes further than the mock rather than away from it, and it is named in the audit's rough for the user to react to.

Built: PhotonzCore/PickedRing.swift (tested in PickedRingTests), flag next-solid-picked-ring (Next only, on by default), CanvasPickedRing.swift (CasedRingLayer: own stroke is the casing, ink sublayer shares its path, so every existing path/isHidden call site is untouched). Multi-selection members get the mock's .mem-ring (1pt at 70%) with a 2.5pt halo, so shift-clicking a second layer does not switch from solid to dotted.

Verified: Scripts/test.sh green (13175 tests); new walk a-picked-layer-wears-the-solid-ring-walk (same-colour tile on white, blue, dark bands; dark and light; two picked) ok at Next defaults with expectPicked claims; framing-a-zoom-keys-its-centre-walk, a-moved-layer-stays-under-what-covers-it, every-handle-lights-on-hover, undo-hands-back-the-pick, multi-drag, marquee-and-track-range all ok.

Rough items: rounded-shape ring curve vs mock's box ring filed as a-picked-rounded-shape-is-ringed-round-its-box-a (p1, conflicts with a 2026-09-08 fix so it starts with a card). Left rough here: the member ring reads grey-ish on dark because the halo outweighs a 70% line; small, and the user can react to it on the audit.

Picked layers and a pushed-in recording's frame now wear the mocks' solid 1.5pt accent ring (multi-selection members the 1pt 70% ring), cased in a faint white halo so it reads on white, blue and dark pictures; Next only via next-solid-picked-ring (on by default), Current keeps the dotted line. Commit 146cb772. Verified with Scripts/test.sh (13175 green), the new a-picked-layer-wears-the-solid-ring-walk at Next defaults in dark and light, and framing-a-zoom-keys-its-centre-walk.
